items.title: Surface manual fallback warnings in recovery views
items.context: When story_get/session_brief sees initCheckAttestation=fallback, render clear language that this was manual fallback attestation, not independent reviewer approval, and that later PLAN/DEV/REVIEW/TEST gates remain required.

items.title: Make init_check_repair output close with a continuation boundary
items.context: After init_check_repair succeeds, its human-facing output should explicitly say fallback repairs only INIT_CHECK and does not authorize implementation or replace later reviewers.

items.title: Add smoke coverage for the fallback continuation guard
items.context: Extend or add focused smoke tests proving story_get exposes fallback, session_brief renders the manual fallback warning, and next-step wording includes the explicit-authorize-before-continuing boundary.
